svg.title: Overlapping zones on a closed circuit
svg.desc: A closed oval with eight sections. A missing inner boundary crosses the left-hand curves and the lower straight; a partially overlapping double-solid centerline zone continues along the lower straight. The upper straight contains a speed-limit zone. Colored brackets follow the resolved spans and mark their endpoints; the blue missing-marking and orange centerline brackets lie outside the oval. The missing-marking label lies inside; the centerline label sits below its bracket.
